capabilities.description: Bind an already configured execution adapter to its exact account and revision. Returns the execution capability reference for any workflow. Does not load, configure or connect a backend, or place an order. Imports legacy receipts when the old manual-trading package is installed.

usage.purpose: Bind an already configured execution adapter to its exact account and revision. Returns the execution capability reference for any workflow. Does not load, configure or connect a backend, or place an order. Imports legacy receipts when the old manual-trading package is installed.
usage.inputs: {backend:"mt5"|"qmt",id?:<stable binding ID>}; e.g. {backend:"mt5",id:"my-account"}. The backend must already be configured; this does not accept login credentials.
usage.outputs: {plugin_id:"sesame/portfolio-execution",context_tool:"portfolio_execution_context",apply_tool:"portfolio_execution_apply",arguments:{binding_id}}; pass this entire object as a workflow execution reference.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.

Loaded MT5 >=2.1.0 (read-only catalog, market/indicator reads and profit/margin calculations via mt5_call) or QMT >=1.4.0 with an existing exact account/revision. If manual-trading is installed it must expose manual_trading_execution_export for safe migration.
Installed implementations: plugin_discover and host.capabilities.list. Published optional packages: plugin_catalog({plugin_id}); installation/loading is a separate public operation.
limitations: Binding ID is immutable for its owner/account/revision. After account/config change create a new binding instead of replacing the old identity.

capabilities.description: Read the bound account identity/capability contract, or its full account snapshot including strategy positions, retained history and mounted strategies. Delegated reads require the frozen execution binding.

usage.purpose: Read the bound account identity/capability contract, or its full account snapshot including strategy positions, retained history and mounted strategies. Delegated reads require the frozen execution binding.
usage.outputs: identity => {account,tools,readTools,taskContext,accountProvider,fillSources,quantityRules}; snapshot => the native full-account snapshot with positions, history and mounts. MT5 quantity unit is signed lots; QMT is nonnegative integer shares.
prerequisites: Owned configure binding, or a delegated workflow task carrying that exact frozen execution binding.
limitations: Snapshot is observation, not permission to trade. ACCOUNT_CHANGED requires a new binding; native mt5_trading_context identity alone is not this composition contract.

A confirmed missing MT5 Python IPC connection returns MT5_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE with details.retryable=false, requiredTransport=python, nativeCode/nativeMessage, commandId and recovery. Reconnect the configured Python terminal and verify the same account before a newly authorized workflow run; repeating a failed snapshot cannot connect it. Other failures keep their native reason without being classified as nonretryable.

capabilities.description: Read this main owner's retained workflow execution applications and their operation IDs, including interrupted runs. Does not submit, resume or replay execution. Query individual order receipts with manual_trade_status.

usage.purpose: Read this main owner's retained workflow execution applications and their operation IDs, including interrupted runs. Does not submit, resume or replay execution. Query individual order receipts with manual_trade_status.
usage.inputs: {binding_id?,run_id?,offset?:0,limit?:20}; run_id is the source workflow business ID.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.
limitations: running/interrupted/blocked does not imply rejection. manual_trade_status on retained operation IDs reconciles evidence; this read never resumes execution.

capabilities.description: Apply one saved target portfolio through the bound execution adapter. Requires a live workflow tool calling for its matching executor task; direct model calls fail. Exact native units, all-origin close/reduction, guarded strategy stops and durable no-replay receipts are preserved.

usage.purpose: Apply one saved target portfolio through the bound execution adapter. Requires a live workflow tool calling for its matching executor task; direct model calls fail. Exact native units, all-origin close/reduction, guarded strategy stops and durable no-replay receipts are preserved.
usage.inputs: {binding_id,run:{id,decidedAt,plan:{id,account,ownerConversationId,slippageBps},decision:{unchanged,targets,pause_strategies,...}}}; all values come from the frozen workflow, not a model-composed authorization object.
usage.outputs: Host Run whose output is the durable application receipt {status,orders,pauses,after,targetReached,...}; retain per-order operation IDs and actual native receipts.
prerequisites: Nested call from a live workflow tool for its matching registered executor task. Models use that workflow's apply capability (e.g. manual_trading_apply), not this adapter directly.
limitations: Capability visibility is not callable authority. Identical saved run reuses its receipt; changed intent conflicts; unknown/interrupted sends are never replayed.

capabilities.description: Inspect supported direct execution channels and enforced latency policy. Does not connect, configure, install, or trade.

usage.purpose: Inspect supported direct execution channels and enforced latency policy. Does not connect, configure, install, or trade.
usage.outputs: {policy,compositionAvailable,backends,unavailable,note}; policy reports measured/enforced time bounds and supported native actions.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.
limitations: Listing a channel does not establish its connection, a successful broker order or profitability.

capabilities.description: Read current account, symbol conditions, positions and a source-timestamped executable quote from an already loaded MT5/QMT backend. Returns an observation_id that starts the model decision clock; no order is sent.

usage.purpose: Read current account, symbol conditions, positions and a source-timestamped executable quote from an already loaded MT5/QMT backend. Returns an observation_id that starts the model decision clock; no order is sent.
usage.outputs: {observation_id,backend,symbol,account,accountSummary,quote,positions,orders?,spec,capturedAt,expiresAt,policy,...}; times are epoch milliseconds. Use the returned observation_id for one intent.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.
Already enabled/configured native backend with a fresh source-timestamped executable quote.
limitations: Observation expires after the decision window and does not authorize execution. An observation consumed by an intent cannot be used for another intent.

MT5 requires the configured Python terminal, not only an EA/MCP quote connection. MT5_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE with details.retryable=false identifies confirmed missing IPC; its recovery field explains the connection/account prerequisites. Account health is checked before the remaining snapshot reads; the capability never logs in or retries automatically.

capabilities.description: Prepare an explicitly authorized manual trade in one call: bind the selected account, establish supported MT5 permissions/Python readiness, then read symbol rules, positions, pending orders and the last native quote. Returns an observation_id and preparation summary; never places an order. QMT uses its existing read-only snapshot.

usage.purpose: Start preparation immediately when the user requests manual trading, while organizing their independent order intent. Use fast manual_trade_execute directly when the complete intent is already known.
usage.outputs: Run output is {status:"prepared",observation_id,backend,symbol,account,accountSummary,quote,positions,orders?,spec,preparation,capturedAt,expiresAt,timing,submission_attempted:false,...}; or {status:"rejected",error:{code,message,details},submission_attempted:false,...}. Original raw source quote time and receive time are retained; preparation time is separate from the quote age.
prerequisites: Main conversation only, with an existing explicit user trading instruction. Workflow/executor delegation cannot use this authorization path.
MT5 2.1.6+ with mt5_trading_prepare and an already configured account. QMT requires its existing configured native connection.
limitations: MT5 may enable its trading gate, prepare algorithmic/Python permissions or normally restart its configured terminal; it must retain the same account. Preparation has a separate 180-second bound. QMT never changes permissions or connections.

Same operation_id and same input returns the stored result without repeating preparation. Stale/future source quotes reject with measured age; timestamps are never replaced. Preparing is not prepared, order authorization or a submitted order.

Unknown prior account orders block preparation. No research/team/deployment/history preflight is required for this manual path; native permission and SDK recovery steps have ordering constraints, not guaranteed parallel execution.

capabilities.description: Submit one explicitly user-authorized order. Supply either observation_id or backend + symbol; the latter prepares and executes in one call with no model round trip. M5+ only. Exact account, positions, source quote freshness and price guards still apply at native dispatch. Same operation_id and original input returns the stored receipt; query unknown outcomes, never resend.

observation_id.description: An unused ID from manual_trade_observe or manual_trade_prepare; cannot be combined with backend or symbol

quantity.description: MT5 lots or QMT integer shares, based on the user intent

price_limit.description: Maximum buy/minimum sell executable quote. A market fill can still slip; use a limit order for a hard order-price limit

position_id.description: Required MT5 position ticket for close

usage.purpose: Submit one explicitly user-authorized order. Supply either observation_id or backend + symbol; the latter prepares and executes in one call with no model round trip. M5+ only. Exact account, positions, source quote freshness and price guards still apply at native dispatch. Same operation_id and original input returns the stored receipt; query unknown outcomes, never resend.
usage.inputs: {operation_id,observation_id OR (backend,symbol),user_authorized:true,action:"market"|"limit"|"close",side,quantity,price_limit,timeframe?,limit_price?,position_id?,stop_loss?,take_profit?}. Exact original order intent is required in either mode; never infer quantity, side or price bounds. limit requires limit_price; MT5 close requires position_id. timeframe defaults5m; 1h does not schedule repetition.
usage.outputs: Run output is one durable command record {id,status,submission_attempted,receipt?,evidence?,intent,preparation?,timing,error?}. Rejected preflight explicitly reports submission_attempted:false with the original error reason. Fast mode records preparation timing and model_round_trip_ms:0. Native acceptance and observed fills are different; query manual_trade_status(refresh:true) for recovery.
prerequisites: Main conversation only. Backend + symbol preparation cannot be used by workflow/executor delegation.
An existing explicit, complete user order intent. Either a recent unused observation or an already configured account with MT5 2.1.6+ mt5_trading_prepare / existing QMT connection.
limitations: Stable operation_id + identical original input prevents duplicate preparation and sends. An operation ID cannot be reused with a different intent or observation. Fast mode does not guess an order from the returned quote.
price_limit bounds the executable quote, not a guaranteed market fill. Use a limit order for a hard order-price bound. Final native account, positions, price and freshness guards remain enforced.
Preparation is bounded separately from final execution. An unknown dispatched command must be reconciled under its original ID; neither a timeout nor an absent order authorizes a replacement.

capabilities.description: Read a durable receipt; refresh reads the backend command and actual orders/fills for recovery. No matching record never proves a timed-out send failed. Does not replay or place orders.

usage.purpose: Read a durable receipt; refresh reads the backend command and actual orders/fills for recovery. No matching record never proves a timed-out send failed. Does not replay or place orders.
usage.outputs: Stored command; refresh:true additionally reads native command/orders/fills, records evidence and checkedAt, and may resolve an uncertain state.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.
The operation belongs to this conversation; refresh requires the same configured account.
limitations: No matching order or deal does not prove a timed-out send failed. A native accepted receipt and an observed fill are distinct evidence.

capabilities.description: Request cancellation of a confirmed pending order created through this plugin, using a separate stable operation ID. Does not close a filled position. Query afterwards; cancel_requested is not confirmed cancellation.

usage.purpose: Request cancellation of a confirmed pending order created through this plugin, using a separate stable operation ID. Does not close a filled position. Query afterwards; cancel_requested is not confirmed cancellation.
usage.outputs: Host Run output is a durable cancellation record with originalOperationId, receipt and status (cancel_requested/rejected/outcome_unknown); status(refresh:true) reads the original order evidence.
prerequisites: Main conversation only; task/tool names do not grant a delegated Agent this authority.
User cancellation intent for a confirmed pending order created through this plugin.
limitations: cancel_requested is not confirmed cancellation and cannot close an already filled position. Unknown cancel results retain the same cancellation ID.

capabilities.description: Close the private durable receipt database after all execution settles.

usage.purpose: Close the private durable receipt database after all execution settles.
prerequisites: Host lifecycle only after active work settles.
limitations: Does not issue broker cancellation or delete retained receipts.
